text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can obtain Support Cards from the<n>
Support Card Scout!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A Support Card is a card used to assist<n>
your trainees in Career.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By selecting a deck of Support Cards,<n>
you'll receive the aid of others around<n>
Tracen Academy to help your trainee<n>
along!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's try our hand at scouting<n>
some Support Cards!
